name: unity
description: Develop Unity projects with the official Unity CLI and local Editor pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: Edit, test, and build Unity projects with official tools.
interface.longDescription: Use the official Unity CLI and Pipeline package for local Editor control, scene changes, C# diagnostics, tests, and builds. Live Editor control targets Unity 6.0 LTS or later; the upstream CLI is experimental. Requires a matching installed and licensed Editor. This OhMyGame workflow does not install a community MCP bridge or register other AI clients. Disabled by default.
